c1.qes.greet.en: Good morning, Deacon Isaac. Peace be with you. You are early, as always.
c1.qes.greet.am: እንደምን አደርክ ዲያቆን ይስሐቅ። ሰላም ለአንተ ይሁን። እንደ ሁልጊዜው ቀድመህ መጣህ።

c1.isaac.greet.en: Bless me, Abba. What needs doing before the Kidase?
c1.isaac.greet.am: አባ ይባርኩኝ። ከቅዳሴ በፊት ምን ላድርግ?

c1.qes.tasks.en: Light the candles and prepare the censer for me. Then start that camera of yours: our people far away pray with us through it.
c1.qes.tasks.am: ሻማዎቹን አብራ፣ ጽናውንም አዘጋጅልኝ። ከዚያ ካሜራህን አስጀምር፤ በሩቅ ያሉ ወገኖቻችን በእርሱ ከእኛ ጋር ይጸልያሉ።

c1.qes.ride.en: One more thing. Ato Tesfaye lives just around the corner, but he cannot walk in this cold. Will you bring him?
c1.qes.ride.am: አንድ ነገር ቀረ። አቶ ተስፋዬ ቤታቸው ቅርብ ነው፣ ግን በዚህ ብርድ መራመድ አይችሉም። ታመጣቸዋለህ?

c1.isaac.ride.en: Of course, Abba. I will be back before we begin.

c1.elder.hello.en: Isaac, my son! Minus eighteen and you still come for an old man. God bless you.
c1.elder.hello.am: ይስሐቅ ልጄ! በዚህ ብርድ ለሽማግሌ መጣህ። እግዚአብሔር ይባርክህ።

c1.elder.car.en: Drive gently. The ice does not care how late we are.
c1.elder.car.am: ቀስ ብለህ ንዳ። በረዶው መዘግየታችንን አያውቅም።

c1.elder.ontime.en: In good time. Let us go in.

c1.elder.late.en: A little late, but we arrived safely. That matters more. Let us go in.
c1.elder.late.am: ትንሽ ዘገየን፣ ግን በሰላም ደረስን። ዋናው እርሱ ነው። እንግባ።

c1.kidase.1.en: The Kidase begins. The Qes censes before the curtain; the chanters keep time with staff and sistrum.
c1.kidase.1.am: ቅዳሴው ጀመረ። ቄሱ ከመጋረጃው ፊት ያጥናሉ፤ መዘምራኑ በመቋሚያና በጸናጽል ዜማውን ይጠብቃሉ።

c1.kidase.2.en: Behind the curtain is the Meqdes, where the Tabot rests. Only the clergy enter.
c1.kidase.2.am: ከመጋረጃው በስተጀርባ ታቦቱ ያረፈበት መቅደስ ነው። የሚገቡት ካህናት ብቻ ናቸው።

c1.end.en: A small church on 5th Street, on the frozen prairie. And it is full.
c1.end.am: በ5ኛው ጎዳና ላይ ያለች ትንሽ ቤተ ክርስቲያን። ሞልታለች።

c2.elder.1.en: You want to know how we began? Sit. It did not begin with a building.
c2.elder.1.am: እንዴት እንደ ጀመርን ማወቅ ትፈልጋለህ? ተቀመጥ። በሕንፃ አልጀመረም።

c2.elder.2.en: A few families, far from home, praying in a living room. Then we found this little church.
c2.elder.2.am: ከሀገራቸው የራቁ ጥቂት ቤተሰቦች በመኖሪያ ቤት ይጸልዩ ነበር። ከዚያ ይህችን ትንሽ ቤተ ክርስቲያን አገኘን።

c2.isaac.1.en: Our anniversary is coming. I want to put the whole story in a video for the channel.
c2.isaac.1.am: የምሥረታ በዓላችን ቀርቧል። ታሪኩን ሁሉ በቪዲዮ ማዘጋጀት እፈልጋለሁ።

c2.elder.3.en: Then close your eyes, and I will show you how it looked.
c2.elder.3.am: እንግዲህ ዓይንህን ጨፍን፤ እንዴት እንደ ነበረ አሳይሃለሁ።

c2.founder.1.en: The tower is plain wood and the steps are green. But it is ours.
c2.founder.1.am: ግንቡ ተራ እንጨት ነው፣ ደረጃውም አረንጓዴ። ግን የእኛ ነው።

c2.founder.2.en: Help me carry the books in. We have a wagon full of them.

c2.founder.3.en: One day there will be a gold dome up there. You will see.
c2.founder.3.am: አንድ ቀን በላይ የወርቅ ጉልላት ይኖራል። ታያለህ።

c2.mother.1.en: We painted the tower blue, and for Timket we hung our flag. Everyone on 5th Street could see it.
c2.mother.1.am: ግንቡን ሰማያዊ ቀባነው፤ ለጥምቀት ሰንደቅ ዓላማችንን ሰቀልን። ሁሉም አየው።

c2.mother.2.en: Thank you. The elders must not slip on these steps.

c2.isaac.2.en: Everyone who remembers is right here in this room. I only have to ask.
c2.isaac.2.am: የሚያስታውሱት ሁሉ እዚሁ ክፍል ውስጥ ናቸው። መጠየቅ ብቻ ነው።

c2.photo.1.en: We were students then, praying wherever we could find a room. Here: the very first photograph.
c2.photo.1.am: ያኔ ተማሪዎች ነበርን፤ ክፍል ባገኘንበት እንጸልይ ነበር። ይኸው የመጀመሪያው ፎቶ።

c2.photo.2.en: My mother baked the first bread for this church in her own kitchen. I have her picture.
c2.photo.2.am: እናቴ ለዚህ ቤተ ክርስቲያን የመጀመሪያውን ዳቦ በራሷ ማዕድ ቤት ጋገረች። ፎቶዋ አለኝ።

c2.photo.3.en: The year we painted the tower blue, half the paint ended up on us children.
c2.photo.3.am: ግንቡን ሰማያዊ የቀባንበት ዓመት፣ ግማሹ ቀለም በእኛ በልጆቹ ላይ ነበር።

c2.photo.4.en: When the gold dome went up, we all wept. I filmed it on my phone. Take it for your video.
c2.photo.4.am: የወርቅ ጉልላቱ ሲሰቀል ሁላችንም አለቀስን። በስልኬ ቀርጬዋለሁ። ለቪዲዮህ ውሰደው።

c2.end.en: Uploaded. A whole community's memory, in six minutes.
c2.end.am: ተጭኗል። የአንድ ማኅበረሰብ ትዝታ በስድስት ደቂቃ።

c3.qes.1.en: Meskel eve is tonight. We need the city's fire permit, branches for the Demera, and adey abeba to dress it.
c3.qes.1.am: የመስቀል ዋዜማ ዛሬ ማታ ነው። የከተማው የእሳት ፈቃድ፣ ለደመራ ቅርንጫፍ፣ ለማስጌጫም አደይ አበባ ያስፈልገናል።

c3.isaac.1.en: Leave it to me, Abba. The elms dropped plenty of branches in last night's wind.
c3.isaac.1.am: ለእኔ ተዉት አባ። ትናንት ማታ ነፋሱ ብዙ ቅርንጫፍ አውርዷል።

c3.clerk.1.en: An open-air fire, in town? What is it for?

c3.isaac.2.en: Meskel — we remember the finding of the True Cross. A small bonfire in the church yard, with water and extinguishers ready.
c3.isaac.2.am: መስቀል — የቅዱስ መስቀሉን መገኘት እናስባለን። በግቢው ውስጥ ትንሽ ደመራ፤ ውኃና ማጥፊያ ተዘጋጅቷል።

c3.clerk.2.en: Approved. Keep it clear of the trees. And happy Meskel.
c3.clerk.2.am: ተፈቅዷል። ከዛፎቹ አርቁት። መልካም የመስቀል በዓል።

c3.qes.2.en: Beautiful. Tonight, when it burns, watch which way it falls.
c3.qes.2.am: ያማረ ነው። ማታ ሲነድ ወደየት እንደሚወድቅ ተመልከት።

c3.night.1.en: Evening. The community gathers in white. Three times they circle the Demera, singing.
c3.night.1.am: ምሽት። ማኅበረሰቡ ነጭ ለብሶ ተሰብስቧል። እየዘመሩ ደመራውን ሦስት ጊዜ ይዞራሉ።

c3.qes.3.en: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit, one God. Amen.
c3.qes.3.am: በስመ አብ ወወልድ ወመንፈስ ቅዱስ አሐዱ አምላክ። አሜን።

c3.fall.east.en: It fell to the east! The elders say that is a year of peace.
c3.fall.east.am: ወደ ምሥራቅ ወደቀ! ሽማግሌዎች የሰላም ዓመት ነው ይላሉ።

c3.fall.south.en: It fell to the south. A good harvest, the elders would say.
c3.fall.south.am: ወደ ደቡብ ወደቀ። ሽማግሌዎች መልካም መከር ነው ይላሉ።

c3.fall.west.en: To the west. We will argue about what that means until next Meskel.
c3.fall.west.am: ወደ ምዕራብ። ምን ማለት እንደ ሆነ እስከሚቀጥለው መስቀል እንከራከራለን።

c3.end.en: Whatever it means — we are here, together.

c4.qes.1.en: Minus thirty-five, and a blizzard tonight. Timket does not wait for the weather. Is everything ready?
c4.qes.1.am: ከዜሮ በታች ሠላሳ አምስት፤ ማታ ዐውሎ ነፋስ አለ። ጥምቀት አየር አይጠብቅም። ሁሉ ተዘጋጅቷል?

c4.isaac.1.en: I will see to the rides home, the steps and the umbrellas.

c4.driver.1.en: Between the truck and the van we can take everyone but one family.
c4.driver.1.am: በጭነት መኪናውና በቫኑ ከአንድ ቤተሰብ በቀር ሁሉንም እንወስዳለን።

c4.driver.2.en: The van is warm. I will take the grandmothers.

c4.driver.3.en: If the storm comes early, the grandmother and the little one will need you, Deacon.
c4.driver.3.am: ዐውሎ ነፋሱ ቀድሞ ከመጣ አያቲቱና ትንሹ ልጅ አንተን ይፈልጋሉ ዲያቆን።

c4.qes.2.en: Good. Vest, and take an umbrella. The Tabot goes out covered, and it is never without shade.
c4.qes.2.am: ጥሩ። ልብሰ ተክህኖ ልበስ፣ ጃንጥላም ያዝ። ታቦቱ ተሸፍኖ ይወጣል፤ ያለ ጥላም አይሆንም።

c4.qes.3.en: The Tabot rests by the water tonight, and we keep vigil. But look at the sky. Take the grandmother home first.
c4.qes.3.am: ታቦቱ ዛሬ ሌሊት በውኃው አጠገብ ያድራል፤ እኛም እንተጋለን። ግን ሰማዩን ተመልከት። አስቀድመህ አያቲቱን ወደ ቤት አድርስ።

c4.storm.1.en: I can barely see the street. Slow. Just slow.
c4.storm.1.am: መንገዱን ማየት አልችልም። ቀስ። ቀስ ብቻ።

c4.family.2.en: God keep you on these roads, my child.

c4.bless.1.en: Morning. The storm has passed. The Qes prays over the water and lowers the cross into it.
c4.bless.1.am: ጠዋት። ዐውሎ ነፋሱ አልፏል። ቄሱ በውኃው ላይ ጸልየው መስቀሉን ወደ ውኃው ያወርዳሉ።

c4.bless.2.en: The blessed water is sprinkled over everyone — steam rising in the cold, children laughing.
c4.bless.2.am: የተባረከው ውኃ በሁሉም ላይ ይረጫል — በብርዱ እንፋሎት ይወጣል፣ ልጆች ይስቃሉ።

c4.end.en: Thousands of kilometres from the Jordan, in a prairie winter. And still: Timket.
c4.end.am: ከዮርዳኖስ በሺህ ኪሎ ሜትሮች ርቀን፣ በክረምት። ግን አሁንም፦ ጥምቀት።

c5.isaac.1.en: Holy Week. Exams in the mornings, the fast, and the church every evening. One thing at a time.
c5.isaac.1.am: ሰሙነ ሕማማት። ጠዋት ፈተና፣ ጾም፣ ማታ ማታ ቤተ ክርስቲያን። አንድ በአንድ።

c5.friend.1.en: There you are! Exams are done. We are getting burgers. Are you in?
c5.friend.1.am: እዚህ ነህ! ፈተናው አለቀ። በርገር ልንበላ ነው። ትመጣለህ?

c5.isaac.2.en: Thanks, but I'm fasting until Easter — our Easter. Come by the church on Sunday morning; there will be more food than you have ever seen.
c5.isaac.2.am: አመሰግናለሁ፣ ግን እስከ ፋሲካ እጾማለሁ። እሑድ ጠዋት ወደ ቤተ ክርስቲያን ና፤ አይተህ የማታውቀው ምግብ ይኖራል።

c5.friend.2.en: Deal. Good luck with... all of it.

c5.qes.1.en: You are tired, my son. So were the ones who kept watch that night. Rest a little, and come for the vigil.
c5.qes.1.am: ደክሞሃል ልጄ። በዚያች ሌሊት የጠበቁትም ደክመው ነበር። ትንሽ ዕረፍ፣ ለሌሊቱ ጸሎት ና።

c5.tensae.1.en: Kristos tensa'e ke'mutan!  —  Christ is risen from the dead!

c5.tensae.2.en: Be'abiy hayl wesiltan! — With great power and authority!

c5.end.en: The same doors, the same stairs. No snow now. One year — and I would not trade a day of it.
c5.end.am: ያው በር፣ ያው ደረጃ። አሁን በረዶ የለም። አንድ ዓመት — አንድ ቀንም አልለውጥም።

c1.gospel.en: The Holy Gospel. Stand in fear and listen.

c1.kidase.3.en: The deacon's place is beside the priest: to carry the light, to call the people to prayer, to ring the bell.
c1.kidase.3.am: የዲያቆኑ ቦታ ከካህኑ አጠገብ ነው፦ ብርሃን መያዝ፣ ሕዝቡን ለጸሎት መጥራት፣ ቃጭል መደወል።

c2.qes.mahlet.en: Good. The staff carries us through the long hours; the sistrum and the drum carry the praise.
c2.qes.mahlet.am: ጎበዝ። መቋሚያው በረጅሙ ሰዓት ይደግፈናል፤ ጸናጽሉና ከበሮው ምስጋናውን ይሸከማሉ።

c5.tensae.5.en: Selam! From now on, joy and peace.
